# repo-health

> Score a local repository checkout on docs, tests, CI, security and maintenance with ten weighted offline checks and a grade. Python package `trysac-repo-health`, import name `repo_health`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model, defenses and limits
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): the test module and how to run it

## Optional

- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): tools used and discarded
- [Project](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope and effort record
